Notes: CDIAL 1577 indradhanuṣ explicitly means rainbow. Dhundari īndradanūs retains the full compound and is linked as learned Sanskrit vocabulary, with deaspiration and vowel length retained and intra-Indo-Aryan transmission open. Exact survey form īndradanūs is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 114 aṅga explicitly means limb/body and gives regional aṅg. Bundeli ang body fits this noun without adding an unsupported suffix. Exact survey form ang is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 10434 yavanāla explicitly gives Hindi jundrī millet. Survey jundari millet (husked) fits this millet noun with an inserted vowel and the processing qualification preserved. Exact survey form jundari is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 5239 jīva gives regional jiu/jiw life and explicit mind/heart senses in its addenda. Dang jiw heart is compared with that vital-spirit noun, preserving the elicited heart sense rather than claiming it is always anatomical. Exact survey form dʒiw is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 2963 kavāṭa gives Hindi kiwāṛ door and regional stop-bearing kavāḍ forms. Buksa kiwaḍ fits the same whole door noun with stop/flap and vowel details retained. Exact survey form kɪwaɖ is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 6459 *duvāra gives Nepali duwār and regional duār door. Dang dawar fits that expanded door stem with the unstressed vowel retained. Exact survey form dʌwaɾ is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 5523 *ḍag section 1 explicitly gives Oriya ḍagara road and regional ḍagar. Dang ḍagara path matches the retroflex branch, not dental dag in section 3. Exact survey form ɖʌɡʌɾa is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 9882 markaṭa explicitly gives Khowar mukuḷ monkey. Survey mūkūl directly matches that whole word, with lateral quality and vowel length preserved. Exact survey form mūkūl is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 5070.2 *chokhara explicitly gives Awan chòr boy, beside Lahnda chohur. Saraiki cor fits this regional contracted boy stem, with initial aspiration/tone notation preserved rather than imposed. Exact survey form cor is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 13676 stabdha section 2 documents the cold sense and the influenced thaṇḍha/ṭhaṇḍha forms, including Hindi/Punjabi ṭhaṇḍā and Lahnda ṭhaḍā. Awan ṭhanḍā and Saraiki thaḍa fit that cold family; their dental/retroflex details and the deeper contact influence noted by Turner remain qualified. Exact survey form ṭʰanḍā is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 1340.2 *ālla explicitly gives Bashkarik āl wet and neighboring ālo. Bashkarik ālū selects this contracted lateral wet family with the final vowel retained. Exact survey form ālū is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 13139 sapta explicitly gives Bashkarik sat and Torwali sāt seven. Survey sāʔt/sātʔ fits this numeral, with glottal articulation preserved rather than interpreted as an extra morpheme. Exact survey form sātʔ is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 1388 ālu explicitly gives Bihari aluā potato, noting Hindi transmission. Danuwar alua matches that expanded potato noun; the regional route remains open. Exact survey form alua is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

CDIAL 10636 explicitly gives Nepali rāmro good and Western Pahari rāmṛā under its -ḍ extension. Jambu promotes this to 10636-2 *ramyaḍ-. Dotyali rāmaro fits that extension with an inserted vowel retained. Exact survey form rāməro is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.
